an3.25:1.5: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo,
an3.25:1.6: appam pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati patiṭṭhīyati kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti.
an3.25:1.7: Seyyathāpi nāma duṭṭhāruko kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhīyosomattāya āsavaṃ deti,
an3.25:1.8: evam eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti . . . pe . . .
an3.25:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . . dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an3.25:2.3: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave cakkhumā puriso rattandhakāratimisāya vijjantarikāya rūpāni passeyya,
an3.25:2.4: evam eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhan ti . . . pe . . . dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an3.25:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an3.25:3.3: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave vajirassa n' atthi kiñci abhejjaṃ maṇi vā pāsāṇo vā,
an3.25:3.4: evaṃ eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an3.25:3.6: Ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 26.6
